answer_1.quote: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) is an effective solution to solve the incompletion problem. KGE aims to learn the low-dimensional vectors (embeddings) for entities and relations based on the observed triples in KGs.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate our method, three metrics are used, including Mean Rank (MR), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and Hit@10 (e.g. the accuracy in top 10 predictions).
